card.name: Verbs of studying in academic prose
card.fires_on: Words that introduce a scholarly study or analysis, such as "examined", "studying", "analyzing", or "of" after "analysis" or "interpretation". Found in social science and academic writing and citations.

modes.label: Study verbs
modes.description: Verbs saying researchers examined or analyzed something.
modes.example: one of us was part of a team that<< examined>> how tornadoes affect voting behavior.

modes.label: Of after analysis nouns
modes.description: The word "of" after a noun such as analysis, interpretation or acceptance.
modes.example: Freud's interpretation<< of>> lesbian behavior has since been rejected by most

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Punctuation or title words in reference lists just before a paper title.
modes.example: Tellis G., Stremershen S., Yin E. (2003<<),>> The international takeoff of new products:

card.writes: It suppresses words like scholars and contributions, so it holds back academic-credit wording after a study is introduced.
card.plain: It fires on words that say someone studied or analyzed a topic in academic writing.
